'''Xavier Dade''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Standing 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], he was streetwise and skilled in survival, conning others, brawling, and dodging. He carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] and wore a set of [[Clothing/Legends|robes]].<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xavier Dade was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Dade's character type was listed as "Male Minor Jedi" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
